answer: New identities enter through a 4-week probation lane: each must post a 25 POA deposit and complete 6 paid micro-jobs, with 20% of results re-checked by a random reviewer. An island of 1,000 fakes locks 25,000 POA and needs 6,000 jobs, with cost growing linearly, while an honest operator pays once for one identity. Cheating on a re-check forfeits 80% of the deposit, so the juniper-sized rewards from a fake never repay the timber of capital it ties up.
